summary: Maps the source measurement representation to the assigned station engineering quantity.
description: Maps the source measurement representation to the assigned station engineering quantity. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Raw measurement and scale” at the input and “Engineering-unit measurement” at the output. Scale and units require explicit configuration.
